conventions.translation: subtract minimum x and minimum y of the whole cell set
conventions.agent_exchange: sort the two coordinate starts; both initial states are 0
conventions.success: Manhattan distance <=1 at any integer time, including time0
conventions.d4: r(x,y)=(-y,x), s(x,y)=(x,-y); rs means r after s
conventions.transport: a provenance normalizer g sends original A to normalized gA; stored concrete instance is translated g^{-1}(source instance)
conventions.aliases: shape=cells; start is the pair of indices in sorted cells; n=size; schemas=schema_ids
conventions.scope: Only terminal upper-proof leaves; no additional start pairs, optional path-normal-form necessities, or audit-only lock variants
